August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 110)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 25 across American network, three classic newspaper hardboiled cases of Casey, Crime Photographer across two lead actors (Staats Cotsworth & Darren McGavin) and two sponsors (Anchor Hocking & Philip Morris), Peter Tinniswood's uproarious Antarctic cricket memoirs on BBC Radio 4, Joseph Cotten & Teresa Wright on Armed Forces Radio Theater, and children's fables on The Story Lady (1945–1981):
